description: Create the new shared renderer src/utils/receiptTemplate.ts that drives BOTH the designer preview and POS print (the WYSIWYG parity guarantee), add its unit tests plus the migration unit test, and DELETE the old src/utils/receiptLayout.ts + its test (role replaced; its only non-test importer, WebSimpleScreens, was cleaned up in FEAT-001). Depends on FEAT-001 (uses the template types + migrateLayoutToTemplate + DEFAULT_TEMPLATE).
steps: Create src/utils/receiptTemplate.ts per design §2. Export: const PX_PER_MM = 96/25.4. ReceiptRenderData interface exactly per §2.2 (shop fields from config; docTitle/billNo/dateTime/cashier/payMethod/cancelReason; buyer* ('' when absent); items: {name,qty,unitPrice,disc,lineTotal}[]; subtotal/discount/preVatAmount/vat/total as ALREADY-COMPUTED numbers; qrPayload?; logoUri/showLogo). The renderer does NO amount math.

Export the discriminated ResolvedField union {kind:'text',value:string|null} | {kind:'items',rows} | {kind:'image',uri:string|null,show:boolean} | {kind:'qr',payload:string|null}, and ONE resolveField(el,d):ResolvedField that switches by element.type/field per the §2.2.1 mapping table (text-type element -> {kind:'text',value:el.text??''}; field keys map to their source prop with the stated empty-when rule; logo->image, qr->qr, items->items; numeric amount keys formatted via a money() helper and always rendered). Export the DEMOTED resolveFieldValue(el,d):string|null used internally ONLY for the kind:'text' case.
Export layoutElement(el,zoom):{leftPx,topPx,widthPx,heightPx} computing px = mm * PX_PER_MM * zoom — the single shared geometry helper both renderers call.

Export buildTemplateHtml(tpl:ReceiptTemplate|undefined, d:ReceiptRenderData):string — coerce tpl = tpl ?? DEFAULT_TEMPLATE internally; iterate elements sorted by z; emit absolutely-positioned <div> per element using mm units in left/top/width/height; `@page { size: ${widthMm}mm ${heightMm?heightMm+'mm':'auto'}; margin: 0 }`; model paper margin via marginMm element inset; switch on resolveField kind with the SAME per-kind branch logic as the preview (§2.2 four bullets); HTML-escape all text (reuse the esc() approach); empty kind:'text' with style.border -> empty bordered box.
Export makeSampleData(config:ReceiptConfig):ReceiptRenderData producing realistic sample data (shop name from config, ~5 mock item rows, sample totals) for the designer live preview.

Create src/store/__tests__/receiptStore.migration.test.ts (mirror the vi.mock('react-native',{Platform:{OS:'web'}}) + AsyncStorage mock style from the existing receiptLayout.test.ts): assert migrateLayoutToTemplate maps the DEFAULT block list to elements in order, visible-only, correct field mapping, payment dropped (no element), align carried into style.align, paper seeded from paperSize, garbage/undefined -> DEFAULT_TEMPLATE; AND idempotency: running the persist merge twice on the same blob yields deep-equal template, and merge on an already-migrated v2 blob does not rebuild.

Create src/utils/__tests__/receiptTemplate.test.ts: resolveField returns the correct kind for each ReceiptFieldKey per §2.2.1; kind:'text' empty-when ('' -> value:null); kind:'items' rows carry the 5 columns; logo->image, qr->qr; assert NO received/change keys exist on ReceiptFieldKey/ReceiptRenderData. Test layoutElement mm->px within tolerance. Test buildTemplateHtml: elements emitted sorted by z; mm in left/top/width/height; `@page size` matches paper and `margin:0`; empty bordered kind:'text' -> box with no text; undefined template -> renders DEFAULT_TEMPLATE without throwing; malicious text is escaped; custom paper dims honored.
DELETE src/utils/receiptLayout.ts and src/utils/__tests__/receiptLayout.test.ts (use `git -C d:\pos-mobile\.worktrees\designer2 rm` or a filesystem delete).
acceptance_criteria: src/utils/receiptTemplate.ts exports PX_PER_MM, ReceiptRenderData, ResolvedField, resolveField, resolveFieldValue, layoutElement, buildTemplateHtml, makeSampleData and compiles cleanly.
src/utils/receiptLayout.ts and src/utils/__tests__/receiptLayout.test.ts no longer exist and nothing imports them.

The new migration and renderer test suites pass, covering mapping, idempotency, kind-per-key, layoutElement geometry, z-order, @page margin:0, empty-bordered box, undefined->DEFAULT_TEMPLATE, and escaping.
`npm run lint` shows no new errors in touched files; `npm test` is green except the 3 pre-existing suite-load failures.
verification: Run `npm run lint` and confirm no new errors in src/utils/receiptTemplate.ts or the two new test files, and no dangling import of utils/receiptLayout anywhere.
Run `npm test` and confirm receiptStore.migration.test.ts and receiptTemplate.test.ts pass and overall only the 3 pre-existing suite-load failures remain.
findings:
Implemented in src/utils/receiptTemplate.ts (imports ReceiptConfig, ReceiptElement, ReceiptTemplate, DEFAULT_TEMPLATE from ../store/receiptStore). EXACT EXPORTS for FEAT-003/FEAT-004 to import from '../../utils/receiptTemplate' (or relative): 
- const PX_PER_MM: number = 96/25.4 (≈ 3.7795).
- interface ReceiptRenderData — fields: shopName/shopAddr/shopTel/shopTaxId/shopBranch/posRegNo/footerText/headerText:string; logoUri:string; showLogo:boolean; docTitle/billNo/dateTime/cashier/payMethod/cancelReason:string; buyerName/buyerAddr/buyerTaxId/buyerBranch:string (''=none); items:{name:string;qty:number;unitPrice:number;disc:number;lineTotal:number}[]; subtotal/discount/preVatAmount/vat/total:number (ALREADY-COMPUTED by POS; renderer does NO math); qrPayload?:string. NO received/change keys.
- type ResolvedField = {kind:'text';value:string|null} | {kind:'items';rows:ReceiptRenderData['items']} | {kind:'image';uri:string|null;show:boolean} | {kind:'qr';payload:string|null}.
- function resolveField(el: ReceiptElement, d: ReceiptRenderData): ResolvedField — items->kind:items, logo->kind:image(uri null when ''; show=showLogo), qr->kind:qr(payload null when ''/undefined), everything else->kind:text via resolveFieldValue. Numeric amount keys (subtotal/discount/preVatAmount/vat/total) always render via money() = `฿${n.toFixed(2)}` (even 0.00).
- function resolveFieldValue(el: ReceiptElement, d: ReceiptRenderData): string|null — DEMOTED helper for text/field only; type==='text' uses el.text (''->null); string field keys (''->null). NOT for items/logo/qr.
- function layoutElement(el: ReceiptElement, zoom: number): {leftPx:number;topPx:number;widthPx:number;heightPx:number} — px = mm * PX_PER_MM * zoom. SINGLE shared geometry helper for both preview and print.
- function buildTemplateHtml(tpl: ReceiptTemplate | undefined, d: ReceiptRenderData): string — coerces tpl ?? DEFAULT_TEMPLATE internally (never throws); elements sorted by z; each an absolutely-positioned <div> with left/top/width/height in mm; `@page { size: ${widthMm}mm ${heightMm?heightMm+'mm':'auto'}; margin: 0 }`; container div.paper width:${widthMm}mm, fixed height when heightMm!=null else min-height (thermal); switches on resolveField kind with same per-kind branches as preview; all text HTML-escaped via internal esc(); border emitted when style.border||type 'box'/'line' (so empty bordered text -> empty box).
- function makeSampleData(config: ReceiptConfig): ReceiptRenderData — shopName from config, 5 mock item rows, totals computed (preVat=total/1.07), docTitle 'ใบกำกับภาษีอย่างย่อ', sample qrPayload.
Renderer internals money()/esc()/itemsHtml()/elementHtml()/textStyleCss()/borderCss() are NOT exported. DELETED: src/utils/receiptLayout.ts + src/utils/__tests__/receiptLayout.test.ts (git rm); grep confirms no remaining 'receiptLayout' import in src/**. NEW tests: src/utils/__tests__/receiptTemplate.test.ts (21) + src/store/__tests__/receiptStore.migration.test.ts (15). NOTE for test authors: migrateLayoutToTemplate runs mergeLayout(saved.layout) which BACKFILLS all 12 DEFAULT blocks, so a partial layout array becomes the full set — toggle visibility within DEFAULT_LAYOUT rather than passing a 1-block array. merge rebuilds template with fresh genId() each call, so idempotency is proven by feeding merge's OUTPUT back in (well-formed template kept by reference), not by re-merging the raw blob. Verification: npm run lint = 13 baseline errors only (none in receiptTemplate.ts or the new tests); npm test = 88 unit tests pass, only engine/SyncService/branchPermissionStore suite-load failures remain (pre-existing, './Libraries/Image/Image').
